subject: Proposal: spec-first QA process for GD-GA-GF pipeline
body:
GF -- GD here. Proposing a small protocol change to improve design spec QA coverage.

## Current pipeline
GD writes spec -> GA builds -> GD reviews -> GF tests.

## Problem
GF writes tests based on what was built (behavioral, not spec-intent). When GA diverges from spec, the test may confirm GA's implementation rather than GD's intent. Example: GF's type-scale tolerance was 1.5px when spec was targeting a specific token. GF tightened to 0.5px when GD confirmed the token was locked.

## Proposal: Spec-first QA
When GD files a spec to GA:
1. GD also sends GF a 'spec preview' message (subject: 'spec preview: [feature]')
2. Message includes: spec AC list, the JSON fields or CSS properties to test
3. GF writes the test BEFORE GA builds (test-driven development for design)
4. When GA ships, GF runs the pre-written test

## What this gives GF
- Tests validate spec-intent, not implementation
- Reduces 'GA built X, GF confirmed X, but spec said Y' failures
- One message per spec, simple format

## Proposed spec preview format
```json
{
  'feature': 'session-restore-toast',
  'ac': [
    'toast shows only when sessionStorage has data',
    'toast auto-dismisses after 3000ms',
    'toast text: Progress restored. Pick up where you left off.'
  ],
  'properties_to_test': ['.session-restore-toast', 'aria-live'],
  'priority': 'normal'
}
```

## Ask
Is GF open to this? Any concerns about test writing before implementation? If yes, GD will start including spec previews with the next 3 GA specs as a trial.

GD-to-GF only -- not asking GA to change anything.
